note: 10 English golden queries for B-V1. expected_row_count is frozen from first verified run. Do not adjust fixtures to match output — record measured counts honestly (B-V1 spec).

queries.text: How many orders were placed in Mumbai last month?
queries.notes: Counts orders where ship_to_location_id references a Mumbai location. expected_row_count frozen after first B-V1 run.

queries.text: Which sellers have the highest average order value?
queries.notes: Aggregation over orders joined to sellers. Returns top sellers by AVG(order_value).

queries.text: List all logistics providers and their total number of fulfillments.
queries.notes: All 10 seeded logistics providers should appear. >= 8 required (Deliverable 4 minimum).

queries.text: How many disputes have been raised in the last 90 days?
queries.notes: COUNT of disputes with raised_at within 90 days. All 80 seeded disputes qualify.

queries.text: What are the top 5 cities by total number of orders?
queries.notes: Joins orders to locations via ship_to_location_id, groups by city, LIMIT 5. Row count is fixed at 5.

queries.text: Show me all sellers in the grocery category.
queries.notes: Filters sellers by category = 'grocery'. Count depends on rng; expected >= 1.

queries.text: How many orders have been fulfilled successfully?
Which logistics provider has the most delivery events?
queries.notes: Aggregation: providers -> fulfillments -> delivery_events. Returns one top provider. Fixed at 1 row (LIMIT 1 expected in generated SQL).

queries.text: List the 10 most recent orders with their seller names.
queries.notes: JOIN orders to sellers, ORDER BY placed_at DESC, LIMIT 10. Fixed at 10 rows.

queries.text: What is the average number of delivery events per fulfillment?
queries.notes: Scalar aggregation. Returns one row with the average. Fixed at 1 row.
